intro: I'm Jonaed, a web developer and competitive programmer from Bangladesh. I enjoy building practical web applications, exploring how software works, and improving the way I approach problems.
summary: My journey started in 2022 with Python basics on a mobile phone. What began as curiosity about software, games, and cybersecurity gradually led me toward web development, C++, data structures, algorithms, and competitive programming.
focus: I currently enjoy frontend development the most, especially turning an idea into an interface that feels clear and useful. I also like working through authentication flows and understanding how frontend and backend systems connect.
approach: I learn through documentation, courses, experimentation, and AI-assisted development. I try to understand and review what I implement instead of relying on generated suggestions without checking them.

journey.title: Curiosity Turned Into Code
journey.description: Started learning Python basics on a mobile phone while exploring how software, games, and security-related systems work.

journey.title: Discovering Web Development
journey.description: Moved toward HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and React to understand how interactive websites and applications are built.

journey.title: Strengthening Problem-Solving Skills
journey.description: Began studying C++, data structures, and algorithms while participating in competitive programming.

journey.title: Building and Improving
journey.description: Working on full-stack projects, improving frontend development skills, and continuing to practice algorithmic problem solving.

interests.title: Web Development
interests.description: Building responsive, practical interfaces and understanding the systems that support them.

interests.title: Competitive Programming
interests.description: Practicing algorithms and learning to approach challenging problems with clearer reasoning.

interests.title: Cybersecurity
interests.description: Exploring security concepts out of curiosity, with an interest in learning more deeply in the future.

interests.title: Continuous Learning
interests.description: Exploring ideas across software engineering, data engineering, and technology.

beyondCode: Outside programming, I'm curious about psychology, history, law, and how people think. I enjoy gaming, observing nature, and photographing the sky and moon. These interests help me stay curious beyond the screen.
career: I'm looking for opportunities to grow through internships, junior development roles, meaningful collaborations, and suitable freelance projects. My long-term goal is to become a capable software engineer with strong development and problem-solving foundations.
